correctness.rationale: The trace-class rank-one dual formula and the concavity of the weighted trace norm permit averaging any optimizer over AGL(2,q), preserving its mass p on the deleted-line ideal points. Direct line-incidence counting yields the three Gram eigenvalues alpha=(1-p)/q (multiplicity q^2-1), beta=qp/(q+1) (multiplicity q), gamma=beta+(q+1)(1-p)/q (multiplicity one), after normalization by q(q+1). Hence Fq is an exact global Schur norm objective. Strict concavity and endpoint derivative signs imply a unique interior p and determine the total ideal mass of ALL possibly asymmetric optimal weights. The derivative at uniform p is strictly negative. Perturbative substitution gives p=q^-1-2q^-2+6q^-3+O(q^-7/2) and separate sharp deletion/uniform corrections. I reconstructed normalization and boundary p=0,1. Independently built finite-field masks for q=2,3,5, checked spectra and maximizers; these finite tests do not establish the prime-power theorem.
